name: Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa
positioning: Private-island villa resort in the remote Huvadhu Atoll, ringed by a 360-degree house reef, with beach and overwater villas
best_for: Snorkelers and divers who want a house reef around the whole island
Families wanting outdoor, marine-focused activities for children rather than an indoor kids' club

facts.text: The resort is on an island in the remote Huvadhu Atoll in the Maldives.
Villas are split between the beach and above the lagoon, plus the three-bedroom Kiaali Residence at the edge of the house reef.
Every villa has floor-to-ceiling windows and a private deck, and some have plunge pools.
Overwater Sunset Villas have a sun deck with daybed and direct access to the house reef.
Villas have high, angled timber roofs that keep them cool, and drinking water is purified at the hotel and served in recycled-glass bottles.
Children can join hands-on sessions in the marine lab with a resident marine biologist.
The Vidhun Spa has five private villas offering Ayurveda therapies and Dhivehi beys-inspired massages.
KOI is an overwater Japanese restaurant with an open kitchen where guests can interact with the chef.
The Island Grill has a wood-fired oven and tables and swing chairs set on white sand.
The Island Grill serves regionally inspired dishes with flavors and spices native to the southern atolls.
From October 2026 to April 2027, six MICHELIN-starred chefs appear in the resort's Masters of Food & Wine series.

highlights.text: A 360-degree house reef surrounds the island, with coral gardens, colorful fish, rays and reef sharks just steps from shore.
Instead of a traditional indoor kids' club, the resort offers outdoor learning and adventure-based activities for children.
Ocean Lab experiences include plankton observation, shark ecology and Snorkel with Purpose sessions.
Treehouse Dining is set 5 meters above the shoreline, with views of the Indian Ocean and the sunset.
The three-bedroom Kiaali Residence has a private infinity pool and 24-hour butler service.

considerations.text: Getting there from Velana International Airport in Male involves a domestic flight followed by a speedboat transfer.
During the festive season, a mandatory dining experience applies to all in-house guests.
There is no traditional indoor kids' club; children's activities are outdoor and adventure-based.
